english: Waaahh, we finally made it back!
Was Sonico's shoot location in this town?
W-w-what's this? So many people...\nBut why? The people walking around\nfeel strangely familiar...
Hunyaaa!?\nWhy are there so many people?\nIs there a festival or something?
Is this everyone's first time in Akihabara?\nThen I'll be your guide!
Nice! This place looks fun,\nNico-chan! Show us aroundd!
There are tons of shops too!\nHey, hey, do they sell like\nmagic items?
Ah, I'm sure they do!\nThey sell lots of\ninteresting things♪
// SFX: 'pikiin' - a Newtype-style flash of insight
Wh-what IS that a...dult shop?\nI feel strangely drawn to it\nfor some reason...
Sounds fuuun!!\n14's basically an adult, right? Right?\nI wanna go toooo!
Before that, we need to find Sonico's shoot location.
Awawa! That's right!\nI-I'm sorry, senpai!
S-senpai...?
Yes! I'm older than you, but\nin the entertainment world, Tsubasa-chan is my senior,\nso I'd love your guidance!
Ah, um... I see...
F-first, I'd like you\nto take me to where\nyou first saw the light.
Understood!\nThat's our next filming location!\nThen let's go!
// Switch to battle map: Akihabara downtown
Everyone, this way!
Whoa, people wearing forehead protectors to protect their foreheads,\npeople with open gloves on their hands-\neveryone's ready for battle!
Guess it's a rougher town than I thought?
And I sense evil from the paper bag\nthat old guy's holding!\nHe's gotta be a dark sorcerer!
At first, my friends took me all over\nand that's how I learned!
// Black Dejiko and Black Puchiko appear
Ah! That person over there\nis a maid cosplayer!
A maid? A kid that small?
Maybe she's doing it with her mom?\nHow cutee♪
...Wait, something's off.
All those people from before\nhave vanished without a trace.
Ah, now that you mention it...
We'd better be careful around those two.
Huh? Wh-what's wrong?\nC-could it be, another sudden shoot...?
...Take this, nyo.
// Black Dejiko fires beams from her eyes;\nlands a short distance away
She's attacking!
Waaah!! That was suddenn?\nThey look kinda like the kids we fought before we came here!
Uwawaa! Such intensity!\nThe staff's passion for film, no doubt!
Sonico, stay in the rear!\nLeave this to us!
Y-yes! I'll study hard\nfrom everyone's acting!
// Battle start
Ah, the foot traffic's gone...\nThe staff must have\ndirected people away!
Crush the rivals, nyo...
Looks fun, nyu...
(These two... are they after Sonico?)
Watch out so they don't go after Sonico!\nLooks like she's their target!
R-right!\nI'll pray for everyone's safety\nfrom the rear!!
No way! We're short-handed, so\nyou're fighting too!
B-but...
// When enemy reinforcements arrive
Wha!? The cast changed!?
Ufufu, I don't mind this tension!
Strange attacks, though...!\nI can't figure out their intent...
// Battle resumes
Going home, nyo...
Tired, nyu...
They're leaving?
Good work, everyonee!\nAh, did they call cut...?
Well, we survived, so fine, right?
// Battle over
Everyone, good work!\nSuch intensity again...!\nI learned a lot!
(No doubt Sonico was the target.\nYet she's in full shoot-mode...\nwhat does this mean, I wonder?)
(Is there a reason Sonico's being targeted...?)
Hey, Sonico...
Ah! That's right!
Huh, what?
Um... is everyone\nhungry?
I know a delicious ramen shop...\nif you'd like...
Ramen!! Yes, ramen!!\nI'm hungry-is it good there?
Yes! I recommend it! Let's goo!
...True.\nMy partner always said you can't think straight\non an empty stomach.
Yes♪ Let's eat something delicious\nand do our best at the next shoot!
// Sonico starts moving; everyone follows
Man, that was amazingg!\nTonkotsu yogurt ramen, ajitama,\ndouble garlic, extra fat, extra veggies!!
(It looked brutal, but it was delicious...)
Not many people try\nthose toppings right awayy!
And the way you eat is so hearty...\nehehee, it reminded me\nof my friend♪
[NOEL]-chan is amazing...\nI've got to try harder!
(Is that okay for an idol, I wonder...)
Now, for after-meal exercise,\nlet's head to where Nico-chan was working!
Y-yeah...
What's wrong?
It's nothing, let's go.
// Fade to black
This is where you saw the light?
Ah, yes!
[NOEL], find anything?
Nothiiing! How about you, [CLAUDE]?
Huh? That shady shop over there!?\nI'm not going, it's scary...
Listen, [CLAUDE]!\nStop muttering to yourself\nand search properly!
Ah, sorry, sorry!\nBut what am I even looking for...
Well, something shiny, maybe?
// Light appears
Like this, a pikaa flash,\nlike a light...
Wh-!? Huh!? Is this THE thing?
No way!?\nWith zero warning, all of a sudden...!!
[CLAUDE]!!
I told you... it's not me...
// END
